items.markdown:
![Wildlife And Nature In Khao Sok Photos - Elephant Hills, Thailand](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07270930-1672-0139-0000-efec007f58f9:4)
Khao Sok National Park is one of Thailand's oldest and most biodiverse rainforests. It is home to `an estimated 200 wild Asian elephants, rare Malayan tapirs, sun bears, and hundreds of bird species including the great hornbill` . Multi-day jungle and lake safaris offer the best chances of encountering this wildlife.[](https://www.khaosok.com/fauna/) [[1]](https://www.khaosok.com/fauna/)[[2]](https://khaosokwildlife.com/)[[3]](https://www.khaosok.com/)[[4]](https://www.thainationalparks.com/khao-sok-national-park)[[5]](https://www.khaosoktravel.com/khaosok-widelife)[[6]](https://www.khaosokaccommodation.com/khao-sok-national-park)[[7]](https://www.khaosok.com/facts/)[[8]](https://www.khaosok.com/wildlife-in-january/)

Wildlife viewing in Khao Sok is highly unpredictable, with sightings ranging from elusive leopards and gibbons to more common macaques, colorful butterflies, and various snake and lizard species. While independent trekking is possible, guided tours significantly increase your chances of spotting animals, as local guides are skilled at tracking and identifying hidden species.[](https://www.facebook.com/groups/khaolakthailand2019/posts/1687957011712614/) [[1]](https://www.facebook.com/groups/khaolakthailand2019/posts/1687957011712614/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dgccKZoGt2Y&t=55)

Key Wildlife to Look For

- **Primates:** White-handed gibbons, spectacled langurs (dusky leaf monkeys), and crab-eating macaques.
- **Mammals:** Asian elephants, Malayan tapirs, sun bears, barking deer, and otters.
- **Birds:** Over 311 species, including great hornbills, kingfishers, and the Malaysian crested fireback.[](https://www.khaosok.com/fauna/) [[1]](https://www.khao-sok-riverside-cottages.com/khao-sok-jungle-thailand-rainforest/)[[2]](https://www.khaosoktravel.com/insects-and-animals)

Best Ways to Spot Animals To maximize your wildlife experience, experts generally recommend booking specialized multi-day itineraries:[](https://www.khaosok.com/wildlife-in-january/) 

- **Jungle Lake Safaris (Cheow Lan Lake):** Boat tours and lakeside hikes give you access to areas where wild elephants and other animals often come to the water’s edge.[](https://www.khaosok.com/fauna/) [[1]](https://www.khaosok.com/fauna/)[[2]](https://www.khaosoktravel.com/khaosok-widelife)
- **Night Walks:** Joining a guided night trek allows you to spot nocturnal creatures like slow lorises, civets, and a wide array of insects and bats.[](https://www.khaosok.com/fauna/) [[1]](https://www.selectiveasia.com/thailand-holidays/experiences/wildlife-wonder-in-khao-sok-national-park)

For more information or to book a guided excursion, you can explore available options through the official [Khao Sok National Park](https://www.khaosok.com/fauna/) site or specialized operators like [Khao Sok Wildlife](https://khaosokwildlife.com/).
